credential_content_not_logged.reason: The old redactor replaced this boolean assertion and all sensitive string values. A scan can show the redacted files do not expose the fixture filename or a credential value, but cannot prove that no secret was ever present before redaction.

redaction_defect: The former key-name redaction replaced boolean assertions containing credential, token, authorization, password, or prefs. The corrected driver now retains boolean and numeric verdicts while continuing to redact sensitive strings and private paths.
historical_integrity: No file under t035-path-security was rewritten. Its original SHA256SUMS.json remains the governing manifest for that run.
